title: Test adapter
description: A language adapter that runs a test on each side.
---

<!-- generated by docs-site/scripts/generate.sh: do not edit -->

This is the Go interface, with its comments, as `go doc` prints it.

```go
package testrun // import "github.com/saphan-ai/proven/internal/testrun"

type Adapter interface {
	Run(ctx context.Context, req Request) (Outcome, error)
}
    Adapter returns a test outcome. The sample adapter executes no code.
    A *service.Down error means the Prover is off; the review names it among the
    failed services and the finding keeps a query as its evidence.

```
